page.layout: One printed title page. Top to bottom: title block in roman and italic capitals and small capitals; a woodcut illustration in the centre; the imprint at the foot. A handwritten note sits below the imprint.

main_text.l: Librum primum, secundum ac initium tertij:
CLARISSIMI ET DOCTISSIMI VIRI D. PETRI
Huic accessit INDEX rerum & verborum locupletissimus.
rum, Anno à Christo nato M. D. LXXXII.

page.notes: Woodcut between the title block and the imprint: a tree with a figure beside it, a frog and a town with a tower in the background. Not text. Handwritten brown ink note below the imprint, not printed, left out. Handwritten "2" at top right, not printed, left out. Spelling normalised: ETHICORVM, NICOMACHVM, TIGVRI, APVD, CHRISTOPHORVM and FROSCHOVERVM written with u/v as the rules require; uerborum written verborum.
